# PlayerBatch Studio

> PlayerBatch Studio is a local Windows batch-production tool for sports Media Day photographers. It turns one roster CSV and a portrait folder into consistent athlete graphics at roster scale.

## Product
- Name: PlayerBatch Studio
- Tagline: Roster in. Team graphics out.
- Platform: Windows desktop workflow
- Pricing: one-time purchase
- Inputs: roster CSV plus PNG/JPG athlete portraits
- Outputs: 1080x1350 social PNGs, 2400x3000 print PNGs, ZIP delivery files, manifest and failure reporting
- Processing: local athlete matching and local automatic background removal
- Visual systems: Arena Hero, Impact Red, Editorial Profile, Tunnel Gold
- Photoshop: not required
- Paid API: not required for the current release
